names.name: St. Peter’S Wort
names.note: Square stalks, larger and with few dots, damp places; Ascyron of herbals.

cul:235-st-peters-wort.ref: Culpeper, Complete Herbal: St. Peter’s Wort
cul:235-st-peters-wort.text: There is not a straw to choose between this and St. John’s Wort, only St. Peter must have it, lest he should want pot herbs; It is of the same property of St. John’s Wort, but somewhat weaker, and therefore more seldom used. Two drams of the seed taken at a time in honied water, purges choleric humours, (as saith Dioscorides, Pliny, and Galen,) and thereby helps those that are troubled with the sciatica. The leaves are used as St. John’s Wort, to help those places of the body that have been burnt with fire.

cul:235-st-peters-wort.280: purges choler, phlegm or melancholy downwards: cathartic
